variants.headline: Assembly votes the government out
variants.body: The Colonial Assembly has voted the government out in {colony}. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Confidence withdrawn
variants.body: The government has been voted out by the Colonial Assembly. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Office meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: An Assembly vote has removed the government in {colony}. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
